summary: Two linked churches, Holy Spirit (Gloversville) and Holy Trinity (Johnstown). The weekly Mass schedule is clear. Holy Trinity's Sunday 9:00 AM Mass is at Holy Spirit during painting, and its Tuesday and Wednesday Masses are in the parish hall. The first-Thursday Confession and first-Saturday Mass alternate by month and are left out (R33). Open: whether to keep the Holy Trinity Sunday slot while it is moved.
